purpose: Source catalogue for building a national, historical register of public development projects in Bangladesh. This file is a source inventory, not a claim that every project has already been imported.

targetCoverage.geography: Bangladesh, with overseas government projects separately classified

1971.note: ERD's foreign-assistance series begins in FY1971/72. These tables are aggregate aid/commitment/disbursement evidence, not a complete list of named project sites.

1972-1974.note: The national ADP programme begins in FY1972/73. Early Five-Year Plan documents provide programme-level context; individual DPPs and agency archives are needed for project rows.

1975-1999.note: Historical project evidence must be reconstructed from annual ADPs, IMED predecessor records, ministry/agency archives and development-partner files. BWDB preserves selected long-run allocation/expenditure data from 1959/60 onward.

2000-2015.note: Use agency project lists, IMED evaluations, donor project documents, procurement notices and independent reporting. No single national archive currently covers all lifecycle states and exact locations.

2016-2026.note: Annual ADP/RADP lists, current IMED reports, ministry/agency portals and BPPA procurement evidence provide stronger coverage, but project-to-site geometry still needs verification.

2026-2027.note: The FY2026-27 ADP list dated 14 October 2026 lists 1,173 projects over 88 pages. It is a current-year roster snapshot; it is not the full historical register and its allocation list does not itself provide exact site coordinates.

importPolicy.primaryEvidence: DPP/RDPP, ECNEC or competent approval, ministry/agency project register, IMED implementation/evaluation report, ADP/RADP list, completion report, official GIS/route/chainage data, BPPA procurement/tender records, audited records.
importPolicy.secondaryEvidence: News articles, investigative reports, interviews, press coverage, satellite imagery and photographs may identify leads, dates, locations, disputes, delays or cancellation claims. Link each item to the project record, publication date, claim excerpt/summary and source URL; corroborate status and finance against primary records wherever possible.
locationPrecision: official GIS or as-built route geometry
importPolicy.markerRule: Only a surveyed site coordinate or official project-site geometry may create a precise point/line. A district, upazila or locality mention may create an explicitly labelled area/corridor locator only at that supported level. Never geocode a district centroid and present it as a project location.
importPolicy.statusRule: Completed, ongoing, delayed/suspended, cancelled, proposed/planned and future must each be based on dated evidence. A missed end date does not prove suspension; a press report that a project may be cancelled is not final cancellation without confirmation.
importPolicy.deduplication: Match on project code, original DPP title, implementing agency, approval date, geography, financing agreement and predecessor/successor references. Keep phases and revisions linked, not merged without evidence.
importPolicy.privacyAndFairness: Do not publish personal contact details, allegations as facts, or inferred corruption claims. Separate audit observations, reported allegations and established findings.

sources.title: Approved Annual Development Programme (ADP) and Revised ADP archive
sources.coverage: The portal currently shows FY2016-17 onward in its visible archive, including FY2026-27 and recent RADPs.
useFor: project title and code where supplied
sources.limitations: The visible archive does not cover the full 1971-2026 period; not a geospatial site database.

sources.title: List of Project in ADP 2026-27
sources.coverage: FY2026-27; 88 pages; 1,173 project entries; allocation total 19,474,064.07 lakh taka.
sources.importStatus: The map runtime parses the official 88-page PDF through /api/adp-roster. It extracts project code, English title, Bangla location text, ADP allocation and page number; it matches names to the map's division, district, upazila and union boundary names. A static JSON export and verified exact sites are not present.
sources.limitations: The roster is not an exact-location dataset and does not contain a per-project lifecycle status field. Matched dots show administrative areas only; ambiguous repeated place names and rows with no map-name clue remain unlocated.

sources.title: Various reports archive
sources.coverage: Includes monthly ADP implementation progress, annual project lists, monitoring reports and impact/evaluation reports; current portal snapshot displays 94 report entries across paginated results.
sources.limitations: Archive is paginated and not a single complete historical project register.

sources.title: Completed Projects of IMED
sources.coverage: Five IMED-owned completed institutional projects with implementation periods, revised cost and reported cumulative financial progress.
sources.limitations: Only IMED's own listed projects; does not represent all completed projects in Bangladesh. Financial progress is not the same as physical completion.

sources.title: Ongoing projects of IMED
sources.coverage: Three IMED's own ongoing institutional projects as displayed on the page.
sources.limitations: Agency-specific list only; not the national ongoing project count.

sources.publisher: Economic Relations Division (ERD), Ministry of Finance
sources.title: Foreign Assistance to Bangladesh at a Glance (1971/72-2024/25)
sources.coverage: FY1971/72 through FY2024/25.
useFor: project aid and budget support trends
sources.limitations: Aggregate financial series; cannot be treated as a list of individual projects or physical locations.

sources.title: Bangladesh Aid Information Management System (AIMS)
sources.coverage: Development-partner-funded activities and related aid flows; historical depth depends on records entered by donors.
sources.limitations: Public portal requires navigation; project-level temporal and geographic completeness needs validation.

sources.publisher: General Economics Division / Bangladesh Planning Commission
sources.title: History of the Bangladesh Planning Commission
sources.coverage: Planning Commission established on 31 January 1972; describes its responsibility for ADP, Five-Year Plans and appraisal.
sources.limitations: Institutional history, not a project inventory.

sources.publisher: General Economics Division / Bangladesh Planning Commission
sources.title: Five-Year Plan and plan document archive
sources.coverage: Includes the First Five Year Plan 1973-78 and later national plans.
sources.limitations: Plan-level targets are not proof that every named activity became an approved project or was completed.

sources.title: History of project monitoring and evaluation in Bangladesh
sources.coverage: PIB created January 1975; PMD established 1977; renamed IMED in 1982.
useFor: chronology and provenance of monitoring archives
sources.limitations: Does not itself contain project rows.

sources.title: ADP Projects Database and ADP Projects Implementation Database
sources.coverage: IMED ministry/division-wise ADP project and implementation databases; dataset metadata records 2018 release/modified dates.
useFor: historical project roster / progress backfill where the resource file remains accessible
sources.limitations: Data.gov metadata says license not specified and resources timed out during inspection; check rights and file freshness before reuse.

sources.title: LGED Project Information / Project List
sources.coverage: Paged project catalogue covering rural, urban, water, education and other local infrastructure projects.
sources.limitations: The page is paginated; record-level dates, finance and location need individual verification.

sources.title: LGED GIS, digital upazila base maps and infrastructure spatial database
sources.coverage: GIS institutionalised in the early 1990s; upazila base maps digitised nationwide with infrastructure and settlement layers.
sources.limitations: A base map is not proof that a particular project funded or constructed a specific feature; feature provenance and date need checking.

sources.title: BWDB project reports, completed projects and historical ADP reports
sources.coverage: Includes project briefs, completed project lists, completed-project reports for 2007-08 to 2012-13, FY2023-24 completion list and yearwise BWDB ADP allocation/expenditure 1959-60 to 1998-99.
useFor: water, irrigation, barrage, river-training and flood-control projects
sources.limitations: Agency-specific; the 1959-60 to 1970-71 portion predates Bangladesh's independence and must be separately labelled as inherited East Pakistan-era records.

sources.title: RHD approved projects and online road network / chainage records
sources.coverage: Approved project register and route network with road identifiers and chainage.
sources.limitations: Chainage is not a coordinate unless the route alignment and reference origin are verified.

sources.title: BPPA/e-GP procurement notices and contract records
sources.coverage: Procurement notices, tender packages, contract-related records and work locations where specified.
sources.limitations: A tender is not by itself proof of physical completion or final expenditure; distinguish re-tender, cancellation and contract award.

sources.title: Mega projects and initiatives
sources.coverage: The page lists four featured mega-projects: Padma Bridge, Dhaka Metro Rail, Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant and Dhaka Elevated Expressway, with displayed statuses.
sources.limitations: Only featured mega projects; not a comprehensive national register.

sources.title: President's Address 2023 — completed infrastructure projects under Ministry of Cultural Affairs
sources.coverage: Names completed cultural infrastructure initiatives including district/upazila facilities.
sources.limitations: Narrative summary, not a complete project register; dates, finance and coordinates need separate sources.

sources.title: 29 projects scrapped after spending Tk6,755cr
sources.coverage: Reports 29 projects declared closed without completion in FY2024-25, across 12 ministries/divisions, citing IMED's ADP review; names selected projects.
useFor: cross-reference named project and location with official IMED report
sources.limitations: Article is not the full 29-row primary list; article wording and reported costs should be corroborated against IMED's report.

sources.title: Crores spent, plans abandoned: Why govt scrapped notable projects last fiscal
sources.coverage: Reports on the Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Space Observation Centre and other projects; identifies Bhanga, Faridpur as its intended location.
sources.limitations: Use Bhanga/Faridpur as a named-area reference only; article does not provide surveyed coordinates.

sources.title: ADP: Ex-ministers, MPs' 'arbitrary' projects get cancelled
sources.coverage: Reports on proposed and decided cancellations, including local economic-zone and other initiatives.
useFor: candidate cancelled / proposed / halted status leads
sources.limitations: Different projects may be at different decision stages; do not convert a proposal or report into final cancellation without official evidence.

sources.title: Politically driven, unimportant, redundant: Projects worth Tk5,067cr being cancelled
sources.coverage: Reports on proposals to cancel or drop projects and schemes.
useFor: identify candidate projects and overlapping geographic coverage
sources.limitations: A proposed cancellation is not the same as a formal cancellation order.

sources.title: ECNEC scraps one project, sends back another
sources.coverage: Reports on an ECNEC project decision and a Karatoya river-system proposal returned for cost review.
useFor: ECNEC decision and project proposal status clues
sources.limitations: A proposal sent back is not automatically cancelled; confirm with ECNEC minutes or official decision.
